test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 6th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who supervises in an examination hall
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'Invigilator.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the marked option:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Invigilator
 a person whose job is to watch people taking an exam in order to check that they do not cheat. (एक व्यक्ति जिसका काम लोगों को परीक्षा देते हुए देखना है ताकि यह जांचा जा सके कि वे नकल नहीं करते हैं)
 
 
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *The girl stops writing in the exam only after the** invigilator **has yelled at him.*
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Teacher
 someone whose job is to teach in a school or college. (जिसका काम किसी स्कूल या कॉलेज में पढ़ाना हो)
 
 

 Inspector
 someone whose job is to officially inspect something. (कोई जिसका काम आधिकारिक तौर पर किसी चीज़ का निरीक्षण करना है)
 
 

 Examinee
 someone who is taking an examination. (कोई व्यक्ति जो परीक्षा दे रहा हो)
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, from the given meanings, we find that 'Invigilator' is the correct one-word substitute.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct one-word substitute:__ *Invigilator.*
